sentences.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
sentences.zh: 当飞机开始颤动时，乘客们变得紧张起来。

sentences.en: Trust yourself: every heart vibrates to that iron string.
sentences.zh: 相信自己：每一颗心都会被那根铁弦震动。

sentences.en: Hark! midnight from the church tower vibrates through the frosty air.
sentences.zh: 听！午夜的钟声在寒风中回荡。
